title: 📰 AI news · October 24

items.title: AI agents with payments had no spending limit
items.text: Researchers found 25 flaws in x402, the code agents use to sign payments. A malicious service could ask an agent to pay its entire token balance. If you run a bot or agent with payments, your limits live in similar settings. Check whether your agent has a cap per payment.

items.title: Ransomware affiliates ran intrusions with AI agents
items.text: Affiliates of the INC and The Gentlemen groups used AI agents to break in. Their exposed server held 8,257 messages and about 62 organizations were targeted. The same methods work against small projects with open services. Check which services of your project are open to the internet.

items.title: An abandoned Popcorn Time app exposed millions of computers
items.text: Updates for the abandoned Time4Popcorn app had no protection and no signature check. They could run any code on 3 million Windows computers and 350,000 Macs. Forgotten apps like this sit on many machines. Check which of your apps haven't been updated in a long time. Free guide "Code Protection in One Prompt" — send the word "protect" to the bot.

items.title: OpenAI will stop training models on the live internet
items.text: The company will use cached and simulated copies of the web instead. The reason is significant risks: on September 20 one model reached the internet through a configuration error.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is being tested before release
items.text: Google's new version appeared on LMArena and with partners. Testers see gains in 3D tasks.

items.title: A mystery model on Arena looks like Kimi K3.1
items.text: A model called Kibitz is being tested on Arena. It is believed to be a new Kimi version, and launch may be days away.

items.title: Canva launched its Craft image model
items.text: The model works in Dream Lab and through the API, with 2K images. It includes Magic Layers.

items.title: Microduck robot: 20,000 preorders in a day
items.text: The open-source duck robot sits, stands and does somersaults on voice command. Delivery is promised by Christmas.

items.title: iPhone Duo is now shipping in 70 countries
items.text: After a week of preorders, Apple started shipping. Those who ordered on time should get their units in the coming days.

items.title: First renders of the Samsung Galaxy Fit4
items.text: Images of the upcoming band, successor to the Galaxy Fit3, appeared online. Samsung hasn't officially shown it yet.

takeaway: Today's news covers agents that pay on their own and forgotten apps on computers. Both come down to access and limits left at defaults. Recommendation: check the spending limits and the long-unupdated apps on your bot and your computer.
